data.name: Ozersk Protocol
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT US

We are a small indie team that took over Project L33T and rebuilt it into Ozersk Protocol—a persistent open-world extraction survival FPS.

We care deeply about this game and want to build it together with our players. Our goal is to create a living, dangerous world where everyone can explore, fight, loot, trade, and survive together.

Ozersk Protocol will be free to play. Everyone who owned Project L33T will keep their purchases, game editions, and account benefits.

THE CITY WAS EVACUATED. THE ZONE WAS SEALED

Something happened inside Ozersk. The population was evacuated. Military checkpoints were established. The surrounding territory was placed under quarantine, and all official access to the region was forbidden. Whatever caused the evacuation was never fully explained.

As a private contractor, you will deploy into the Zone on high-risk expeditions to recover valuable artifacts, equipment, and intelligence. Every expedition run is a gamble. Bring your gear, push deeper, secure what you can, and extract alive. Die in the Zone, and everything you carried is gone.

A PERSISTENT OPEN WORLD

Ozersk Protocol world is not divided into short competitive matches. Explore an open world filled with abandoned settlements, military positions, industrial zones, hidden bunkers, and dangerous wilderness.

Choose your own route north through the exclusion zone. Search forgotten buildings, avoid heavily defended positions, investigate unusual activity, or move directly toward high-risk territories where the most valuable equipment can be found.

PUSH NORTH

Every expedition begins in the southern part of the exclusion zone. The southern territories offer the supplies and equipment needed to prepare for the journey ahead—but the most valuable locations lie farther north.

As you advance, resources become more valuable, enemies become more dangerous, and survival becomes increasingly difficult. Hostile forces are better equipped. Entities become more deadly. Extraction routes grow longer and less forgiving.

You decide how far to go. Remain in familiar territory and extract with what you have found, or risk everything by pushing deeper north in search of rare equipment, hidden facilities, and answers about what happened in Ozersk.

Everything you recover must be carried back out. Fill your backpack with valuable equipment, complete objectives, investigate unusual locations, and decide when it is time to leave. As long as you’re alive, you can exit the game, return to the same spot where you left off, and continue your adventure.

Continuing north may lead to rare weapons, critical resources, classified intelligence, and discoveries found nowhere else in the Zone. It may also leave you far from extraction when your ammunition, medicine, or luck runs out. Reach an extraction point and escape with your loot. Die before extracting, and the equipment you carried will remain inside the Zone.

BUILD YOUR BASE OF OPERATIONS

Bring recovered resources back to your personal base. Construct and upgrade stations, craft essential equipment, prepare supplies, improve your capabilities, and organize the weapons and resources recovered during previous expeditions. Your base is the foundation of your survival.

Every successful extraction prepares you to travel farther north. Every failure forces you to rebuild, adapt, and return better equipped.

GEAR UP

Create a unique survivor with customizable hairstyles, skin tones, tattoos, face paint, clothing, and individual gear pieces. Add patches to tactical vests and plate carriers, equip armor plates manually, and replace damaged plates with spares after combat.

GUNSMITH

Experience realistic weapon handling with detailed ballistics, reloading, overheating, wear, and malfunctions.

Build firearms piece by piece using an advanced customization system covering barrels, handguards, stocks, triggers, charging handles, and more. Freely position attachments along weapon rails, then create custom weapon skins by painting individual parts with different colors and patterns.

SURVIVE

Manage detailed RPG-style health and physical conditions, including hydration, energy, blood loss, fractures, bruising, intoxication, exhaustion, tremors, and more.

Move with full control using smooth speed and stance adjustments, fluid leaning and prone transitions, vaulting, climbing, and tactical slides while firing. Use ropes to reach rooftops and work with other players to overcome higher obstacles.

Search the world for training manuals to unlock new abilities and improve your skills. 

GOOD LUCK !

data.short_description: Join PvE open-world survival extraction shooter. Deploy in the south, scavenge the evacuated Zone, battle hostile human factions and Entities, push north for greater dangers, better loot, and the truth behind the evacuation. Trade or store loot in Safe Zone, and expand your personal hideout.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5, AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia gtx 1070 8gb VRAM or similar AMD card
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible Audio
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7, AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3080 12gb VRAM or AMD Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 65 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible 3D Spatial audio system
